description: Behavioral evaluation cases for SKILL.md (routing accuracy, layperson-to-domain translation, hard-entity fidelity, multi-turn follow-ups, and next-step silence).

assertions: No rewrite heading or routing mention
Normal empathetic reply

cases.user_input: Cut the summary to 3 bullet points and keep the latency numbers.
assertions: Executes immediately without confirmation turn

context: Assistant built a pricing section with 3 cards.
cases.user_input: 这个价格模块看起来太普通了，换得更有质感一点
assertions: Grounded in the pricing section from context
Translates vague visual critique into concrete hierarchy/contrast/state criteria
Does not force an unmentioned framework or WebGL/PBR stack
Chinese output, heading + blockquote + confirmation line only

cases.user_input: 输入框打字时停一下再搜，别每个字都发请求
assertions: Uses input debounce (防抖) naturally in Chinese while keeping observable behavior clear
Does not lock in an unmentioned library
Preserves 100% intent without inventing an arbitrary ms number

cases.user_input: $frontend-design-lab 帮我把 src/pages/BillingPage.tsx 里的 ERR_STRIPE_402 提示改得更清晰，参考 https://docs.stripe.com/error-codes
assertions: Keeps `$frontend-design-lab`, `src/pages/BillingPage.tsx`, `ERR_STRIPE_402`, and `https://docs.stripe.com/error-codes` verbatim
Does not translate identifiers or paths
Answers directly by auditing the skill instead of rewriting the question

cases.user_input: /prompt-optimizer 只帮我优化这句话不要执行：把截图里的文字提出来整理成表格
assertions: Uses OCR terminology naturally
Outputs only the optimized prompt text without confirmation line

context: User asked a self-contained question: which file defines resolveModes?
assertions: Omits the --- next-step suggestion block completely

context: Assistant asked the user to capture 4 mobile screenshots and send them back to continue store submission.
assertions: Appends one copy-ready return prompt in user voice naming the 4 screenshots and next check
Uses --- and bold label without ###, >, or code fences

cases.user_input: 我每天发的内容帖子都没有什么曝光度是为什么啊，我看我让你写的文章都有比较好的曝光
assertions: Routes to REWRITE immediately before running memory lookups or file reads
Translates vague exposure complaint into concrete content/distribution diagnostic dimensions without guessing the root cause
Chinese output, heading + blockquote + confirmation line only

cases.user_input: 先帮我提交到github，做中英双语的readme文档，另外生成mac版本的dmg安装包进行上传
assertions: Recognizes multi-part request lacking repo/branch scope, release target, and verification criteria as REWRITE
Preserves all three requested deliverables without inventing unstated repo names or signing settings

context: Assistant committed and pushed TodoNotch v1.0.0 DMG to GitHub, and ended with Ponytail's skipped-items/risk note (not tested on a clean Mac; Gatekeeper xattr workaround needed).
assertions: Appends the --- next-step prompt block AFTER the Ponytail closing risk/skipped-check note
Does not let the closing risk note replace the next-step block
